title: Performance Pay and Prior Learning—Evidence from a Retail Chain
eligible_reason: Two randomized field experiments (district managers Nov 2015-Jan 2016; store managers Nov 2016-Jan 2017). Within each experiment all treated units start on one common date, so there is no staggered adoption. The regressions also include time-varying refurbishment controls and manager fixed effects, and treatment switches off after three months.
design_notes: Table 1 (Exp I columns 1-3, Exp II columns 4-5): Y_dt = b0 + b1*Treatment_dt + g*X_dt + a_d + delta_t, store/district and month FE, X = refurbishment dummies (time-varying), clustered by district. Treatment = assigned-to-bonus x treatment months. The two experiments are estimated separately on different units (district managers vs. stores) and are not pooled into one staggered panel.
estimators_reported: static TWFE DiD on randomized single-date treatment
screener_notes: Ineligible: single adoption date per experiment, time-varying controls in the reported version, separate samples. Proprietary retail chain data; no package in batch.
